Live directory admission for a host-persisted tenant during background work.

## Functions

### coldTenantDirectory()

```ts
function coldTenantDirectory(registry): ColdTenantDirectory;
```

Reconstruct background admission from the same host-owned tenant registry. Every
selection and member lookup reads current authority. This adapter has no
credential authority: its authenticate method always refuses requests.
